title: Skill Blocks: How Should an Agent Load Its Skill? A Caching-Correct Comparison of Pre-load, On-Demand Tool-Loading, Progressive Disclosure, and Hybrid
abstract: arXiv:2608.14943v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills are often injected in full on every request, increasing token cost. We compare four content-preserving loading methods: Full, Skill Block, Reference, and Hybrid. Across SearchQA, SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SynthProc, we measure token usage using raw input for single-turn tasks and cache-correct effective input for multi-turn tasks. Results show no universal winner. Hybrid reduces input by 27.4% on SearchQA and 39.8% on SpreadsheetBench. On large multi-turn skills, Skill Block and Hybrid achieve substantial reductions, reaching 62.5% and 52.8% on ScienceWorld and 73.0% and 66.6% on SynthProc. ALFWorld shows smaller gains because procedures are short and repeatedly needed. Paired outcome tests detect no quality differences, though they do not establish equivalence. Overall, conditional loading is most beneficial when large portions of a skill are not needed on every turn.

translated_title: 技能块：代理应如何加载其技能？预加载、按需工具加载、渐进式披露和混合方式的缓存正确比较
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14943v1 公告类型：新 摘要：代理技能通常在每次请求时全部注入，增加了令牌成本。我们比较了四种保持内容不变的加载方法：全量、技能块、引用和混合。在SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和SynthProc中，我们使用原始输入测量单轮任务的令牌使用量，并使用缓存正确的有效输入测量多轮任务。结果显示没有普遍最优的方法。混合方法在SearchQA上将输入减少了27.4%，在SpreadsheetBench上减少了39.8%。对于大型多轮技能，技能块和混合方法实现了显著减少，在ScienceWorld上分别达到62.5%和52.8%，在SynthProc上分别达到73.0%和66.6%。ALFWorld的增益较小，因为其过程简短且反复需要。配对结果测试未检测到质量差异，尽管它们并未确立等价性。总体而言，当技能的大部分内容并非每一轮都需要时，条件加载最为有益。
tldr: 通过比较四种技能加载方法，发现条件加载（如技能块和混合）在大型多轮任务中能显著降低令牌消耗，且不损害质量，但效果依赖于技能的使用模式。
en_tdlr: Comparing four skill loading methods reveals that conditional loading (e.g., Skill Block and Hybrid) significantly reduces token usage in large multi-turn tasks without quality loss, though effectiveness depends on skill usage patterns.
